fields.project_description: Wetstone Exploration will develop a mobile subsea survey system for non-invasive identification of seafloor massive sulfide (SMS) deposits. This technology will utilize an electromagnetic field to rapidly generate 3D images of these deposits, which are rich in critical minerals such as copper, zinc, and silver. By streamlining deep-sea exploration, the project aims to reduce U.S. dependence on foreign sources for these vital materials.
